sloka: भ्राता च तस्य द्वैमात्रः सौमित्रिरपराजितः ।अनुरागेण रूपेण गुणैश्चैव तथाविधः ।। ५.३५.२२।।।।
transliteration: bhrātā ca tasya dvaimātraḥ saumitriraparājitaḥ ।anurāgeṇa rūpeṇa guṇaiścaiva tathāvidhaḥ ।। 5.35.22।।।।

translations.english: "His invincible brother Saumitri born of a different mother is a replica of Rama in affection, charm and virtues.
